topic: Making of different jobs using Sheet metal i.e Butt/Lap joints
syllabus_extract: Making of different jobs using Sheet metal i.e Butt/Lap joints
specific_objectives: 31.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to perform various repair works on aircraft structure

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration and supervised practice of Butt and Lap joint fabrication on sheet metal blanks; Safety precautions include PPE usage, tool handling, and fire safety; Instructor supervision ensures correct alignment and fastening techniques.
intro_questions: What are the two primary types of sheet metal joints used in aircraft structures?
Why is proper joint selection critical for aircraft structural integrity?
List three safety precautions required before starting sheet metal fabrication.

topics: Definition and application of Butt joints
development.content:
Definition and application of Butt joints
Edge preparation for Butt joints
Fastening methods for Butt joints
Inspection criteria for Butt joints

topics: Definition and application of Lap joints
development.content:
Definition and application of Lap joints
Overlap dimensions and edge finishing
Riveting patterns for Lap joints
Common defects in Lap joints

topics: Quality control checks for sheet metal joints
development.content:
Quality control checks for sheet metal joints
Repair techniques for damaged joints
Documentation of joint fabrication
Final inspection and acceptance criteria

summary_questions: Explain the difference between edge preparation for Butt joints versus Lap joints.
Describe the inspection criteria used to verify the quality of a completed Lap joint.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report outlining the steps required to repair a damaged Butt joint on an aircraft structure, referencing the procedures covered in this lesson and anticipating the removal of loose rivets discussed in LP 07.
